sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 6 月 10 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：SPY、SPCX、ORCL、SMCI、QCOM。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • CPI blew out + Trump "I love the inflation": May CPI rose 4.2% YoY, a three-year high (core 2.9%, in line with expectations). When asked whether he was concerned, Trump replied, "I love the inflation," and said inflation would "drop like a rock" after the war ends. The phrase instantly became community-wide meme material and was repeatedly mocked alongside Republican midterm-election anxiety. The market is still pricing in the stagflation narrative: SPY is currently at $729.02 (-1.09%), having surged intraday to $738.38 before sliding all the way back toward $728.5, staging the same "morning pump → morning rug" for the fifth straight day.
  • War with Iran reignites: After a U.S. Apache helicopter was shot down Tuesday night, the U.S. military carried out retaliatory strikes against Iran. Trump said today that the U.S. would be "attacking them very hard" again today, and threw out the stunning claim that "we ship millions of barrels of oil out of Iran every night." WTI rose nearly 3% at one point to $90.76, while Brent approached $94; USO is currently +3.3%. Rystad estimates that 11.8 million barrels/day of combined production capacity across the six Gulf countries has been disrupted, making this the most severe supply shock in modern history.
  • ORCL reports after the close tonight: Market expectations are EPS $1.96 / revenue $19.1B, with the focus on its ability to convert the $553B AI backlog. Options imply a move of around 12.5%. ORCL is currently at $203.85 (-0.96%), with an extremely violent intraday range of $198-212. The community sees it as a binary event that will either "save the market or nail the SaaS coffin shut."
  • SpaceX Friday IPO pricing finalized: IPO priced at $135/share, implying an initial market cap of around $1.77T, making it the largest IPO in history. It will list on Nasdaq under SPCX on Friday (6/12). The narrative that "the market is being drained of $75B+ in liquidity, and the bottom only comes after the bags are unloaded" remains the community’s main framework for explaining the multi-day decline.
  • Hardest-hit individual stocks: SMCI -19.5%, collapsing for a second straight day; QCOM -7%; AVGO -5%; MU -4.2% (huge intraday swing from $890-957); NVDA -2.9%, down to $202, with the $200 life-or-death line close at hand; GOOGL -2%, continuing lower; GLD -3.3%, again underperforming the broader market. AAPL +0.6% is the lone green name among Mag7, while IWM -0.45% unusually outperformed the three major indices.

估计恐惧/贪婪程度：恐惧区域（约 25/100）。一些评论指出，纳斯达克 VIX 已达到 32，VVIX 飙升，0DTE 溢价如此昂贵，以至于“即使方向正确，你也会赔钱”。但还没有达到极度恐惧的程度——一条获得高度赞扬的评论清醒地指出，“在热线电话开通并且你看到多次停止之前，这不算是泡沫破裂。”这种情绪更像是缓慢的、磨人的折磨，而不是彻底的恐慌。

社区氛围：今天的气氛是“多空两败俱伤”——SPY在730附近被压了几个小时，theta掐死了双方的0DTE玩家，特朗普说“我爱通胀”再加上重新开始轰炸伊朗的荒谬消息让社区从昨天的恐慌变成了麻木、自嘲和“要崩了就崩了”的无奈感。方向性共识完全消失；唯一共同的情绪是对算法固定和政策噪音的愤怒。

WSB情绪与实际市场行为：社区情绪比实际跌幅更悲观——SPY仅为-1.1%，但由于同样的剧本已经连续五天上演（假早间突破→反转→中午钉住），参与者的累计损失和心理伤害远远超过整体指数跌幅。一个值得注意的逆势信号：一篇高票理性帖子提醒人们“市场在4个月内上涨了30%，现在仍在上涨20%；这不是世界末日”。与此同时，“我承认我不知道自己在做什么”获得了15个点赞，升至榜首；从历史上看，这种集体投降往往出现在短期底部附近。
